content.short: A no-code AI development platform on Solana that allows users to build applications using natural language.
content.description:
Alchemist AI is a no-code development platform on the Solana blockchain that democratizes software creation. It allows users to build functional applications and web structures using simple natural language, eliminating the need for programming expertise. The platform features the AI Sacred Laboratory, an interactive workspace where users can build and iterate on application prototypes in just minutes.

Creators can monetize their AI-generated apps and games through the Arcane Forge marketplace. The ALCH token powers the ecosystem, facilitating app generation and premium access.
content.meta: Alchemist AI is a no-code app builder on Solana powered by natural language. Explore its AI creation tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
